content:
Apple TV's all-new original comedy series "Brothers" arrives next month, starring Matthew McConaughey and Woody Harrelson. Check out the trailer below.

"Brothers" comedy series will premiere on September 23, created by Lee Eisenberg of "The Office" fame.

Apple TV is currently airing the fourth season of "Ted Lasso," but another highly anticipated comedy is also on the horizon.

"Brothers," starring Matthew McConaughey and Woody Harrelson, is an all-new original series in which the two play fictionalized versions of themselves.

"Brothers" will premiere on Wednesday, September 23, with two episodes dropping on premiere night, followed by one new episode each week through November 4.

The series is created by Lee Eisenberg, who was a key creative force behind the hit sitcom "The Office," serving as a writer and producer during seasons two through six.

Below is the synopsis Apple provided for "Brothers," followed by the trailer:

In addition to "Brothers," several other new titles are landing on Apple TV in September, including a new season of "Slow Horses," the original crime thriller "Last Seen," and the Ryan Reynolds-led film "Mayday."

What did you think of the "Brothers" trailer after watching it? Let us know in the comments.

Apple TV costs $12.99 per month, with discount available through the Apple One subscription bundle.
